title: 2 Feature Requests  AOD & Alarms
body:
Hi,

1st: Is it possible to show the full Xdrip Notification Text (sugar level + trent) on the AOD for AMOLED devices not only the xdrip icon? 

Normaly all new app icons of apps having a notification coming in are shown next to each other in one line, but as soon as i play a song, the full song and Artist name is shown in a new line. So there must be a way to access the aod.

2nd: is it possible to outsource the alarms into a 2nd app.  e. g.  "Xdrip_alarm", or is there a setting for? 

Use Case: you could change the Notification Settings in Android for these two apps separately. So you could deny the steady xdrip notification on your home and lock screen but allowing the alarms.

comments.body:
Okay for points

 1) Are you talking about the Samsung Always on Display? If so, last time I checked it is only system apps which have access to this. If you are using samsung is it the samsung music player which does this?

There might be a lockscreen trick regarding the full screen artist graphic. I did wonder about that but haven't investigated it further.

2) We can emit broadcast events for alarms. xDrip doesn't currently do this but it is part of the roadmap for inter-app communication. As for what to do with this regarding notifications that is a slightly different topic. I expect anyone proficient in tasker could easily produce an app to do what you're looking for once we export the data from xDrip via the broadcasts.

Hi there, thanks for your response.

Yes i meant the Samsung AOD, but i guess this is useable for all AMOLED Devices.
The Media Player i use is Poweramp, so by far not a Samsung exclusive thing.

I already managed to build me a tasker app wich intercepts the Xdrip notification as an event and than reads the value, delta, and direction from the webservice and shows the value as an notification icon wich is visible on the AOD. 
btw it also sends these data via watchmaker plugin to my SW3. Now i can have these values as some kind of complication on any watchface even if the SW3 is only on Android Wear 1.5.
@klausHey Klaus is it possible to share your tasker implementation of a notification icon with the bg value? thx
I believe half of the items in this issue are now addressed by the notification number feature.
Japp, you're right. I close this issue.
